@@ -0,0 +1,310 @@
+# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+# SSH VPN Tunnel Server — Kubernetes Manifests
+#
+# Deploy:
+#   1. Fill in the gw_key secret value (base64-encoded private key)
+#   2. kubectl apply -f k8s-deployment.yaml
+#
+# Requires nodes with:
+#   - /dev/net/tun available
+#   - kubelet --allowed-unsafe-sysctls=net.ipv4.ip_forward,net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding
+#     (or sysctls set by the privileged container via entrypoint)
+#
+# ── NetworkManager (nm-ssh) — first-time / after pod restart ─────────────────
+# nm-ssh runs as root with no TTY, so it cannot interactively accept a new
+# server host key. After every pod recreation (new SSH host keys) run:
+#
+#   sudo ssh-keyscan -p 5500 -H 157.180.4.166 2>/dev/null \
+#     | sudo tee -a /root/.ssh/known_hosts
+#
+# This is only needed when the pod restarts AND the ssh-host-keys PVC was
+# deleted (i.e. the host keys changed). If the PVC persists across restarts
+# the host key stays the same and no action is needed.
+# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+---
+apiVersion: v1
+kind: Namespace
+metadata:
+  name: ssh-vpn
+  labels:
+    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
+    app.kubernetes.io/component: vpn-server
+
+---
+# ── ConfigMap — non-sensitive environment variables ───────────────────────────
+apiVersion: v1
+kind: ConfigMap
+metadata:
+  name: ssh-vpn
+  namespace: ssh-vpn
+  labels:
+    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
+data:
+  # ── SSH ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+  SSH_PORT: "2222"
+
+  # ── Tunnel Device ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+  # tun0 matches nm-ssh "Remote device number: 0"
+  TUN_DEV: "tun0"
+
+  # ── Tunnel IPs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+  TUN_LOCAL_IP: "10.10.10.2"
+  TUN_REMOTE_IP: "10.10.10.1"
+  TUN_NETMASK: "255.255.255.252"
+  TUN_MTU: "1420"
+
+  # ── Routing ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+  LAN_SUBNET: "169.254.1.0/24"
+  LAN_IFACE: ""
+
+  # ── NAT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+  ENABLE_NAT: "yes"
+
+  # ── Auth (non-secret flags) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
+  ALLOW_PASSWORD_AUTH: "no"
+
+  # ── Logging ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+  LOG_LEVEL: "INFO"
+  TUN_MONITOR_INTERVAL: "5"
+
+  # ── Gateway Reverse Tunnel ────────────────────────────────────────────────
+  GW_ENABLED: "yes"
+  GW_HOST: "157.180.4.166"
+  GW_PORT: "1122"
+  GW_USER: "ansible"
+  GW_SSH_KEY_FILE: "/etc/ssh/gw_key"
+  GW_SSH_KEY_B64: "no"
+  GW_EXPOSED_PORT: "2255"
+  GW_PUBLIC_PORT: "5500"
+  GW_BIND_ADDR: "0.0.0.0"
+  GW_RECONNECT_INTERVAL: "30"
+
+---
+# ── Secret — SSH authorized key + gateway private key ─────────────────────────
+# To populate gw_key:
+#   kubectl create secret generic ssh-vpn \
+#     --namespace ssh-vpn \
+#     --from-literal=SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS="ssh-ed25519 AAAA..." \
+#     --from-file=gw_key=/path/to/id_circle_k8s \
+#     --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
+apiVersion: v1
+kind: Secret
+metadata:
+  name: ssh-vpn
+  namespace: ssh-vpn
+  labels:
+    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
+type: Opaque
+stringData:
+  SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS: "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAILaQdRIqPxJpga6IGm00a+YM2251nv6XMSH32o3kJ2YI root@ssh-vpn-server"
+  # Paste the raw PEM content of your gateway private key (id_circle_k8s) below:
+  gw_key: |
+    -----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
+    b3BlbnNzaC1rZXktdjEAAAAABG5vbmUAAAAEbm9uZQAAAAAAAAABAAAAMwAAAAtzc2gtZW
+    QyNTUxOQAAACC2kHUSKj8SaYGuiBptNGvmDNtudZ7+lzEh99qN5CdmCAAAAJijkH9ao5B/
+    WgAAAAtzc2gtZWQyNTUxOQAAACC2kHUSKj8SaYGuiBptNGvmDNtudZ7+lzEh99qN5CdmCA
+    AAAEClowIlE/32LMzjztooEK54+XuwgIy9Ne+FGXlLSS/6zraQdRIqPxJpga6IGm00a+YM
+    2251nv6XMSH32o3kJ2YIAAAADmFuc2libGVAbm9kZTAxAQIDBAUGBw==
+    -----END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
+---
+# ── PVC — SSH host keys (persist to avoid client re-trust warnings) ────────────
+apiVersion: v1
+kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
+metadata:
+  name: ssh-host-keys
+  namespace: ssh-vpn
+  labels:
+    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
+spec:
+  accessModes:
+    - ReadWriteOnce
+  resources:
+    requests:
+      storage: 10Mi
+
+---
+# ── PVC — authorized_keys directory ──────────────────────────────────────────
+apiVersion: v1
+kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
+metadata:
+  name: authorized-keys
+  namespace: ssh-vpn
+  labels:
+    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
+spec:
+  accessModes:
+    - ReadWriteOnce
+  resources:
+    requests:
+      storage: 10Mi
+
+---
+# ── PVC — VPN logs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+apiVersion: v1
+kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
+metadata:
+  name: vpn-logs
+  namespace: ssh-vpn
+  labels:
+    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
+spec:
+  accessModes:
+    - ReadWriteOnce
+  resources:
+    requests:
+      storage: 1Gi
+
+---
+# ── Deployment ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+apiVersion: apps/v1
+kind: Deployment
+metadata:
+  name: ssh-vpn
+  namespace: ssh-vpn
+  labels:
+    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
+spec:
+  replicas: 1
+  selector:
+    matchLabels:
+      app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
+  strategy:
+    type: Recreate   # Required — only one pod may hold the PVCs at a time
+  template:
+    metadata:
+      labels:
+        app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
+    spec:
+      # ── Pod-level security context ───────────────────────────────────────
+      # net.ipv4.ip_forward / net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding are "unsafe"
+      # sysctls blocked by default in Kubernetes (require kubelet flag
+      # --allowed-unsafe-sysctls). Since the container runs privileged,
+      # the entrypoint sets these via `sysctl -w` at container start instead.
+      securityContext: {}
+      imagePullSecrets:
+        - name: regcred
+      containers:
+        - name: ssh-vpn
+          image: registry.app.circle360.net/ssh-vpn-tunnel-server:v1.0
+          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
+
+          # ── Container security — full privileges for TUN/iptables ──────────
+          securityContext:
+            privileged: true          # required for TUNSETIFF ioctl
+            capabilities:
+              add:
+                - NET_ADMIN           # ip link, ip route, iptables
+                - NET_RAW             # raw socket / iptables -j MASQUERADE
+                - SYS_ADMIN           # mount, sysctl inside container
+
+          # ── Environment — non-sensitive from ConfigMap ─────────────────────
+          envFrom:
+            - configMapRef:
+                name: ssh-vpn
+
+          # ── Environment — sensitive from Secret ────────────────────────────
+          env:
+            - name: SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS
+              valueFrom:
+                secretKeyRef:
+                  name: ssh-vpn
+                  key: SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS
+            # Empty/unused secrets kept explicit so entrypoint reads them
+            - name: SSH_ROOT_PASSWORD
+              value: ""
+            - name: GW_SSH_KEY
+              value: ""
+            - name: GW_PASSWORD
+              value: ""
+
+          ports:
+            - name: ssh
+              containerPort: 2222
+              protocol: TCP
+
+          # ── Volume mounts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
+          volumeMounts:
+            - name: ssh-host-keys
+              mountPath: /etc/ssh/server_keys
+            - name: authorized-keys
+              mountPath: /root/.ssh
+            - name: vpn-logs
+              mountPath: /var/log/vpn
+            - name: tun-device
+              mountPath: /dev/net/tun
+            - name: gw-key
+              mountPath: /etc/ssh/gw_key
+              subPath: gw_key
+              readOnly: true
+
+          # ── Health checks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
+          livenessProbe:
+            exec:
+              command: ["pgrep", "-x", "sshd"]
+            initialDelaySeconds: 20
+            periodSeconds: 30
+            timeoutSeconds: 10
+            failureThreshold: 3
+
+          readinessProbe:
+            exec:
+              command: ["pgrep", "-x", "sshd"]
+            initialDelaySeconds: 15
+            periodSeconds: 10
+            failureThreshold: 3
+
+          resources:
+            requests:
+              cpu: "100m"
+              memory: "128Mi"
+            limits:
+              cpu: "500m"
+              memory: "256Mi"
+
+      # ── Volumes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+      volumes:
+        - name: ssh-host-keys
+          persistentVolumeClaim:
+            claimName: ssh-host-keys
+        - name: authorized-keys
+          persistentVolumeClaim:
+            claimName: authorized-keys
+        - name: vpn-logs
+          persistentVolumeClaim:
+            claimName: vpn-logs
+        # TUN character device from the host node
+        - name: tun-device
+          hostPath:
+            path: /dev/net/tun
+            type: CharDevice
+        # Gateway SSH private key from Secret (mode 0600)
+        - name: gw-key
+          secret:
+            secretName: ssh-vpn
+            items:
+              - key: gw_key
+                path: gw_key
+            defaultMode: 0600
+
+---
+# ── Service — exposes the SSH VPN port ────────────────────────────────────────
+# Use type: LoadBalancer if your cluster has a cloud LB provisioner.
+# Use type: NodePort for bare-metal / on-prem (clients connect to node IP).
+# Use type: ClusterIP if you plan to expose via Ingress or a separate LoadBalancer.
+apiVersion: v1
+kind: Service
+metadata:
+  name: ssh-vpn
+  namespace: ssh-vpn
+  labels:
+    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
+spec:
+  type: ClusterIP
+  selector:
+    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
+  ports:
+    - name: ssh
+      port: 2222
+      targetPort: 2222
+      protocol: TCP

commits.content:
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SSH VPN Tunnel Server — Kubernetes Manifests
#
# Deploy:
#   1. Fill in the gw_key secret value (base64-encoded private key)
#   2. kubectl apply -f k8s-deployment.yaml
#
# Requires nodes with:
#   - /dev/net/tun available
#   - kubelet --allowed-unsafe-sysctls=net.ipv4.ip_forward,net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding
#     (or sysctls set by the privileged container via entrypoint)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: ssh-vpn
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
    app.kubernetes.io/component: vpn-server

---
# ── ConfigMap — non-sensitive environment variables ───────────────────────────
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: ssh-vpn
  namespace: ssh-vpn
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
data:
  # ── SSH ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  SSH_PORT: "2222"

  # ── Tunnel Device ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  TUN_DEV: "tun0"

  # ── Tunnel IPs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  TUN_LOCAL_IP: "10.10.10.2"
  TUN_REMOTE_IP: "10.10.10.1"
  TUN_NETMASK: "255.255.255.252"
  TUN_MTU: "1420"

  # ── Routing ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  LAN_SUBNET: "192.168.8.0/24"
  LAN_IFACE: ""

  # ── NAT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ENABLE_NAT: "yes"

  # ── Auth (non-secret flags) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  ALLOW_PASSWORD_AUTH: "no"

  # ── Logging ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  LOG_LEVEL: "DEBUG3"
  TUN_MONITOR_INTERVAL: "5"

  # ── Gateway Reverse Tunnel ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  GW_ENABLED: "yes"
  GW_HOST: "157.180.4.166"
  GW_PORT: "1122"
  GW_USER: "ansible"
  GW_SSH_KEY_FILE: "/etc/ssh/gw_key"
  GW_SSH_KEY_B64: "no"
  GW_EXPOSED_PORT: "2255"
  GW_PUBLIC_PORT: "5500"
  GW_BIND_ADDR: "0.0.0.0"
  GW_RECONNECT_INTERVAL: "30"

---
# ── Secret — SSH authorized key + gateway private key ─────────────────────────
# To populate gw_key:
#   kubectl create secret generic ssh-vpn \
#     --namespace ssh-vpn \
#     --from-literal=SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS="ssh-ed25519 AAAA..." \
#     --from-file=gw_key=/path/to/id_circle_k8s \
#     --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: ssh-vpn
  namespace: ssh-vpn
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
type: Opaque
stringData:
  SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS: "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAILaQdRIqPxJpga6IGm00a+YM2251nv6XMSH32o3kJ2YI root@ssh-vpn-server"
  # Paste the raw PEM content of your gateway private key (id_circle_k8s) below:
  gw_key: |
    -----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
    REPLACE_WITH_ACTUAL_KEY_CONTENT
    -----END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----

---
# ── PVC — SSH host keys (persist to avoid client re-trust warnings) ────────────
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: ssh-host-keys
  namespace: ssh-vpn
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Mi

---
# ── PVC — authorized_keys directory ──────────────────────────────────────────
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: authorized-keys
  namespace: ssh-vpn
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Mi

---
# ── PVC — VPN logs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: vpn-logs
  namespace: ssh-vpn
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi

---
# ── Deployment ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ssh-vpn
  namespace: ssh-vpn
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
  strategy:
    type: Recreate   # Required — only one pod may hold the PVCs at a time
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
    spec:
      # ── Pod-level security context ───────────────────────────────────────
      # net.ipv4.ip_forward and net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding are "unsafe"
      # sysctls — either enable them here (requires kubelet
      # --allowed-unsafe-sysctls flag on every node) or let the privileged
      # container's entrypoint.sh set them via sysctl at runtime.
      securityContext:
        sysctls:
          - name: net.ipv4.ip_forward
            value: "1"
          - name: net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding
            value: "1"

      containers:
        - name: ssh-vpn
          image: registry.app.circle360.net/ssh-vpn-tunnel-server:v1.0
          imagePullPolicy: Always

          # ── Container security — full privileges for TUN/iptables ──────────
          securityContext:
            privileged: true          # required for TUNSETIFF ioctl
            capabilities:
              add:
                - NET_ADMIN           # ip link, ip route, iptables
                - NET_RAW             # raw socket / iptables -j MASQUERADE
                - SYS_ADMIN           # mount, sysctl inside container

          # ── Environment — non-sensitive from ConfigMap ─────────────────────
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: ssh-vpn

          # ── Environment — sensitive from Secret ────────────────────────────
          env:
            - name: SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: ssh-vpn
                  key: SSH_AUTHORIZED_KEYS
            # Empty/unused secrets kept explicit so entrypoint reads them
            - name: SSH_ROOT_PASSWORD
              value: ""
            - name: GW_SSH_KEY
              value: ""
            - name: GW_PASSWORD
              value: ""

          ports:
            - name: ssh
              containerPort: 2222
              protocol: TCP

          # ── Volume mounts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
          volumeMounts:
            - name: ssh-host-keys
              mountPath: /etc/ssh/server_keys
            - name: authorized-keys
              mountPath: /root/.ssh
            - name: vpn-logs
              mountPath: /var/log/vpn
            - name: tun-device
              mountPath: /dev/net/tun
            - name: gw-key
              mountPath: /etc/ssh/gw_key
              subPath: gw_key
              readOnly: true

          # ── Health checks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command: ["pgrep", "-x", "sshd"]
            initialDelaySeconds: 20
            periodSeconds: 30
            timeoutSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3

          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 2222
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3

          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "256Mi"

      # ── Volumes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      volumes:
        - name: ssh-host-keys
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: ssh-host-keys
        - name: authorized-keys
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: authorized-keys
        - name: vpn-logs
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: vpn-logs
        # TUN character device from the host node
        - name: tun-device
          hostPath:
            path: /dev/net/tun
            type: CharDevice
        # Gateway SSH private key from Secret (mode 0600)
        - name: gw-key
          secret:
            secretName: ssh-vpn
            items:
              - key: gw_key
                path: gw_key
            defaultMode: 0600

---
# ── Service — exposes the SSH VPN port ────────────────────────────────────────
# Use type: LoadBalancer if your cluster has a cloud LB provisioner.
# Use type: NodePort for bare-metal / on-prem (clients connect to node IP).
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: ssh-vpn
  namespace: ssh-vpn
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ssh-vpn
  ports:
    - name: ssh
      port: 2222
      targetPort: 2222
      protocol: TCP
